messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Martin <elaine@harborhotels.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite workshop: keycard preprogramming & traveler rider

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for holding the block for our executive workshop, dates 2027-05-11 to 2027-05-13. A few logistics we want to confirm so the onsite experience is seamless: 

- Block details: 38 standard king rooms + 6 suites (VIPs). Please confirm the block code and the cutoff / release date.
- Master bill: procurement needs a provisional master bill with nightly rate breakdown (room rate, tax, F&B attrition) and the billing contact. Can you send a draft PDF we can run through legal?
- Keycards: we need preprogrammed keycards for the 6 VIP suites and 2 staff escort keys (valid 5/10 thru 5/14). Is your night audit able to load custom access windows prior to arrival?
- Preboarding/rider sheet: I'm attaching an attendee rider (redwood_exec_rider_v2.xlsx) that includes arrival windows, bed-type preferences, accessibility requirements, and dietary notes for ~46 travelers. We'll provide the final rooming list 3 weeks out but wanted to surface the outliers now.
- Early arrivals: about 7 guests arrive on 5/10 late evening; can we guarantee luggage hold + express check-in?

Can you confirm ETA for the draft master bill and whether you need any IDs or passport copies for the VIPs ahead of time?

Appreciate it — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com
From: Elaine Martin <elaine@harborhotels.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dominic Park <dominic.park@harborhotels.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop: keycard preprogramming & traveler rider

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the detailed note and the rider spreadsheet — very helpful. Quick confirmations below: 

- Block code: REDWOOD2027 (cutoff 2027-04-20 11:59 PM local). After that rooms released to public inventory.
- Provisional master bill: attached provisional_masterbill_20270401.pdf with nightly rates and estimated tax/service. Nightly rate is $279 + tax for standard king; $559 + tax for suite. We can add F&B estimates once you provide planned function counts.
- Keycards: yes — night audit can preprogram keycards with custom access windows. To do this we need the last name + room number mapping 48 hours prior. If you prefer, we can pre-encode a VIP list and swap on arrival.
- IDs: passports are not required for domestic bookings; for identification we just need full name and DOB for the suite holds so we can match to rooming list.
- Early arrivals / luggage hold: we will provide secure luggage hold and an express check-in desk for arrivals after 8pm on 5/10.

Two quick asks from our side: 
1) Can you confirm any ADA room needs (we show 2 requests flagged on the rider spreadsheet)?
2) Please confirm the contact who will sign the master bill and whether we should route the final to procurement@redwood.com or to an internal signatory.

Attaching the provisional master bill. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Elaine Martin
Senior Sales Manager — Harbor Hotel Group
elaine@harborhotels.com

--

- Marissa: can you review the rider spreadsheet and call out any special dietary or ADA flags we need to escalate? There are two wheelchair-accessible room requests flagged in the sheet and one guest who requests a rollaway + allergy-safe room.
- Karthik: procurement / legal — please confirm whether procurement@redwood.com should receive the master bill or if you want it routed to an internal signer. If legal has redlines, flag them now; we need execution before 2027-04-20 cutoff.

Thanks—quick summary of outliers from the rider (I reviewed redwood_exec_rider_v2.xlsx):

- ADA / accessibility: 2 confirmed wheelchair-accessible rooms (Guests: Aaron Patel, Maya Srinivasan). Need roll-in shower for Aaron (medical note attached in sheet).
- Bed types: 4 mixed room requests where spouses share (2 doubles preferred, 2 kings).
- Dietary: 6 strict GF needs, 3 shellfish allergies, 2 vegetarian + 1 vegan. Please mark these on the banquet spreadsheet; we'll provide final meal counts by 2027-04-22.
- VIP arrivals: 6 VIPs — 2 arrive 5/10 after 10pm, 1 arrives early on 5/11 morning. For late arrivals, please pre-encode VIP keycards for 5/10 22:00 local activation.
- Special concierge asks: 1 airport transfer pickup at 23:30 (flight delayed) — I'll provide flight # once confirmed.

Action items:
- Rachel: confirm with Elaine that night audit can pre-encode VIP cards and that we can deliver name->room mapping 48 hours prior.
- Karthik: let procurement know we will route the draft master bill to procurement@redwood.com; if legal needs redlines, please return by 2027-04-14 so we can sign.

Short reply is fine for me — I can also call Elaine if you'd prefer.

—Marissa

Hi Elaine / Dominic —

Thanks for the provisional master bill. Procurement will accept the draft routed to procurement@redwood.com; legal will review and return any redlines by 2027-04-14. A couple of clarifying notes before execution: 

- Please add a line for incidental billing instructions and specify the night-audit contact (name & direct dial) who will manage pre-encoded keycards and late arrivals. We will need a single point of contact for day-of adjustments.
- Please confirm the refund/attrition policy if we land at 42 vs 46 room nights.
- For VIP keycards: confirm whether you can program 48-hour activation windows and whether the hardware supports a temporary escort key (staff key that opens suite + all public spaces).

Once those items are in the final master bill, procurement will process signature. Copying procurement@redwood.com to start collection of required billing PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Rachel / Marissa, I will escalate any legal redlines asap.

Best,
